project_type: Kotlin/Java Spring Boot + Vert.x web reader application
verification_instructions: Run ./gradlew compileKotlin compileJava -x test and verify BUILD SUCCESSFUL
setup_instructions: Build is already green. Java 11 + Gradle wrapper available.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. JAR reference at /workspace/jarx/BOOT-INF/classes/. Use javap -p to inspect class signatures.
contribution_requirements: All changes must compile. Compare source against decompiled JAR classes for fidelity.
key_patterns: Controllers extend BaseController with coroutineContext. Suspend functions for async handlers. CURD interface for CRUD operations. Extension functions in VertExt.kt compiled into ExtKt.class.
directory_structure: src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/ contains api/ (controllers, YueduApi), config/, db/, entity/, init/, utils/, verticle/. src/main/java/io/legado/app/ contains the book engine. src/main/resources/ has web/ and simple-web/ frontends.
